sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Repeal Act 1963
sections.description:
Short and commencement

THE REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (REPEAL)
THE REPRESENTATION
OF THE PEOPLE (REPEAL)
ACT, 1963.
ACT No. XXIII of
1963
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1963,
Ext p. 811bg.)
[23rd December,
1963]
An Act to repeal the Representation of the People Act, 1957
1. Short and commencement------(1)
This Act may be called the Representation of the People (Repeal) Act, 1963.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the twenty-third day of March,
1962.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Repeal Act 1963
sections.description:
Repeal etc

THE REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (REPEAL)
THE REPRESENTATION
OF THE PEOPLE (REPEAL)
ACT, 1963.
ACT No. XXIII of
1963
(For Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gaz. of P., 1963,
Ext p. 811bg.)
[23rd December,
1963]
An Act to repeal the Representation of the People Act, 1957
2. Repeal etc.-(1) The
Representation of the People Act, 1957, is hereby repealed, and shall be deemed
to have been repealed on the twenty-third day of March, 1962. XXXI of 1957.
(2) No person shall be deemed to
be, or to have ever been, disqualified from being elected as, or from being, a
member of the National Assembly or a Provincial Assembly under or by reason of
any provision of the said Act, and no election of any person to such Assembly
shall be called in question in or before any court, tribunal or other authority
on the ground that such person was so disqualified under the said Act at the
time when he was so elected.
